title: Immunology Hub — Dermatology (referral to first fill)
summary: A hub for a self-injectable dermatology biologic: referrals by fax, e-referral and HCP portal with missing-info loops, benefits investigation per payer, prior authorization with appeals and re-authorization, co-pay card, free drug and bridge supply, maker-checker specialty pharmacy triage across two limited-distribution pharmacies, hub tasks with SLAs, SMS and WhatsApp outreach, case documents and a case 360 page.
